description: Lists Compute Engine disks. Details for each disk include name, ID, description, creation timestamp, size, type, status, last attach timestamp, and last detach timestamp. Requires project and zone as input.

inputSchema.description: Request message for listing disk basic info.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of results per page that should be returned.

pageToken.description: Optional. The page token received from the previous call.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

zone.description: Required. The zone of the disks to list.

name: list_disks

id.description: The unique identifier for the disk.

lastAttachTimestamp.description: Last attach timestamp of the disk.

lastDetachTimestamp.description: Last detach timestamp of the disk.

sizeGb.description: Size of the disk in GB.

x-google-enum-descriptions: Source data is being copied into the disk.
Disk is currently unavailable and cannot be accessed, attached or detached.

type.description: URL of the disk type resource.

outputSchema.description: Response message for listing disk basic info.

disks.description: The list of disk basic info.

nextPageToken.description: The page token to retrieve the next page of results.
